summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the 11-requirement iteration (RTL Arabic ISP ERP). All 11 pytest backend tests passed (login, dashboard KPIs pos_debts + customer_debts-excludes-pos, /stock period, /cards category filter, /notifications broadcast + log, /admin/quick-recharge/list with period, regression on balances). All frontend data-testids for the changed screens are present and interactive: Dashboard shows exactly 4 KPI cards (sales-today, sales-month, cust-debts, pos-debts) and 8 quick shortcuts including quick-send-notification and quick-reports; forbidden legacy KPI labels (purchases, supplier debts, cards sold/available, inventory value) are absent. Accounts screen renders as card grid (9 acc-card-* found), transfer summary stats removed, only عدد الحسابات + صافي الأرصدة remain, clicking a card navigates to /accounts/pos/<id>. SendNotification standalone screen works, POST /notifications/broadcast succeeds and log shows the new item. Settings no longer contains bc-title/bc-message/bc-send. Reports tab exposes rep-period-day/month/year/custom/all + start/end. Cards screen has cards-list-cat, cards-status, cards-search, cards-count and cards-period-*. Quick recharge history toggle reveals qr-hist-period-* + qr-hist-search. Regression: بقالة الحمادي balance = 2000 and a customer with balance 1000 both verified.

design_issues.screen: Quick recharge history + custom period ranges
issues: Custom range date fields use the browser-native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy input) instead of the shadcn Calendar component. Not blocking but inconsistent with app styling.

action_items: Optional: replace native <input type="date"> in PeriodFilter with shadcn Calendar/Popover for visual consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4538 lines - consider modularizing (routers by domain).
/cards endpoint uses limit 2000 and no pagination; may need pagination as data grows.
Stock period query does an in-memory loop over sales_in_period per category (O(cats*sales)); acceptable at current scale but could be aggregated in Mongo for larger datasets.
seed_data_creation: Broadcast 'TEST_notif' and 'TEST_UI_notif' inserted into notifications broadcast log during tests (non-destructive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_period_filters.py. Run with: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration_period_filters.py -v -o addopts=''  (pytest.ini configures xdist which conflicts if not installed with -n auto). Frontend covered via data-testid presence + smoke interactions. Test injects broadcast rows starting with 'TEST_' - safe to leave.
